frequency_question: How often do executive agency principals successfully finalize high-priority regulatory actions within a 9-to-12 month window when acting under direct mandate?
membership_rule: Includes major rules promulgated by executive departments (like DHS or DOL) designated as high-priority priorities by administration principals. Excludes minor technical amendments and rules abandoned due to internal policy shifts.

cases.name: DHS Border Wall Fund Reallocation Actions (2019)
EPA Clean Power Plan Repeal / ACE Rule (2019)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named prominent executive agency actions driven directly by administration priority; representative of high-will executive actions.
known_gaps: Excludes rules that languished at lower bureaucratic levels due to lack of principal attention.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 identified comparable high-priority executive rulemakings pushed aggressively by principals.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to the operational tempo and principal focus of the current presidential administration, valid for its duration.
